<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance" id="Definitions_OnlineShop" targetNamespace="http://example.org/bpmn/online-shop">
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_LoginRequest" name="Login request"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_LoginResult" name="Login result"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_OrderSubmission" name="Order submission"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_PaymentData" name="Payment data"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_ShippingAddress" name="Shipping address"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_PaymentConfirmation" name="Payment confirmation"/>

  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collaboration_OnlineShop">
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Customer" name="Customer" processRef="Process_Customer"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_EShop" name="E-Shop System" processRef="Process_EShop"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Bank" name="Bank"/>

    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_LoginRequest" name="Login request" sourceRef="Task_SendLoginRequest" targetRef="Start_LoginRequest" messageRef="Msg_LoginRequest"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_LoginSuccess" name="Login result" sourceRef="Task_SendLoginSuccess" targetRef="Event_WaitLoginResult" messageRef="Msg_LoginResult"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_LoginFailure" name="Login result" sourceRef="Task_SendLoginFailure" targetRef="Event_WaitLoginResult" messageRef="Msg_LoginResult"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_OrderSubmission" name="Order submission" sourceRef="Task_SendOrder" targetRef="Event_WaitOrder" messageRef="Msg_OrderSubmission"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_PaymentData" name="Payment data" sourceRef="Task_SendPayment" targetRef="Event_PaymentDataReceived" messageRef="Msg_PaymentData"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_ShippingAddress" name="Shipping address" sourceRef="Task_SendShipping" targetRef="Event_ShippingReceived" messageRef="Msg_ShippingAddress"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_PaymentConfirmation" name="Payment confirmation" sourceRef="Participant_Bank" targetRef="Event_PaymentConfirmed" messageRef="Msg_PaymentConfirmation"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_Customer" name="Customer" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_Customer" name="Start shopping"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_EnterLogin" name="Enter login credentials"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendLoginRequest" name="Send login request" messageRef="Msg_LoginRequest"/>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Event_WaitLoginResult" name="Login result received">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MED_LoginResult" messageRef="Msg_LoginResult"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gw_LoginCheck" name="Login successful?"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_ShoppingStopped" name="Shopping stopped"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gw_ProductMerge" name="Product selection loop"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_SelectProduct" name="Select product"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_AddToCart" name="Add product to cart"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_SaveProduct" name="Save product"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_CheckAllSelected" name="Check whether all products are selected"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gw_AllSelected" name="All products selected?"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendOrder" name="Send order submission" messageRef="Msg_OrderSubmission"/>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gw_CustFork" name="Split into payment and address"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_EnterPayment" name="Enter payment data"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendPayment" name="Send payment data" messageRef="Msg_PaymentData"/>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Event_PaymentConfirmed" name="Payment confirmation received">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MED_PaymentConfirmation" messageRef="Msg_PaymentConfirmation"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_EnterShipping" name="Enter shipping address"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gw_BillingSplit" name="Billing address differs from shipping address?" default="Flow_BillingSame"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_EnterBilling" name="Enter billing address"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gw_BillingMerge" name="Address entry merge"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendShipping" name="Send shipping address" messageRef="Msg_ShippingAddress"/>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gw_CustJoin" name="Payment and address completed"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_OrderPlaced" name="Order placed"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_C01" sourceRef="Start_Customer" targetRef="Task_EnterLogin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_C02" sourceRef="Task_EnterLogin" targetRef="Task_SendLoginRequest"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_C03" sourceRef="Task_SendLoginRequest" targetRef="Event_WaitLoginResult"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_C04" sourceRef="Event_WaitLoginResult" targetRef="Gw_LoginCheck"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_C05" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gw_LoginCheck" targetRef="Gw_ProductMerge">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${loginSuccessful}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_C06" name="No" sourceRef="Gw_LoginCheck" targetRef="End_ShoppingStopped">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${!loginSuccessful}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_C07" sourceRef="Gw_ProductMerge" targetRef="Task_SelectProduct"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_C08" sourceRef="Task_SelectProduct" targetRef="Task_AddToCart"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_C09" sourceRef="Task_AddToCart" targetRef="Task_SaveProduct"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_C10" sourceRef="Task_SaveProduct" targetRef="Task_CheckAllSelected"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_C11" sourceRef="Task_CheckAllSelected" targetRef="Gw_AllSelected"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_C12" name="No" sourceRef="Gw_AllSelected" targetRef="Gw_ProductMerge">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${!allProductsSelected}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_C13" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gw_AllSelected" targetRef="Task_SendOrder">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${allProductsSelected}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_C14" sourceRef="Task_SendOrder" targetRef="Gw_CustFork"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_C15" sourceRef="Gw_CustFork" targetRef="Task_EnterPayment"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_C16" sourceRef="Gw_CustFork" targetRef="Task_EnterShipping"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_C17" sourceRef="Task_EnterPayment" targetRef="Task_SendPayment"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_C18" sourceRef="Task_SendPayment" targetRef="Event_PaymentConfirmed"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_C19" sourceRef="Event_PaymentConfirmed" targetRef="Gw_CustJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_C20" sourceRef="Task_EnterShipping" targetRef="Gw_BillingSplit"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_C21" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gw_BillingSplit" targetRef="Task_EnterBilling">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${billingAddressDiffers}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_BillingSame" name="No" sourceRef="Gw_BillingSplit" targetRef="Gw_BillingMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_C22" sourceRef="Task_EnterBilling" targetRef="Gw_BillingMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_C23" sourceRef="Gw_BillingMerge" targetRef="Task_SendShipping"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_C24" sourceRef="Task_SendShipping" targetRef="Gw_CustJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_C25" sourceRef="Gw_CustJoin" targetRef="End_OrderPlaced"/>
  </bpmn:process>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_EShop" name="E-Shop System" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_LoginRequest" name="Login request received">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MED_LoginRequest" messageRef="Msg_LoginRequest"/>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:serviceTask id="Task_CheckCredentials" name="Check login credentials"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gw_CredValid" name="Credentials valid?"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendLoginSuccess" name="Send login confirmation" messageRef="Msg_LoginResult"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendLoginFailure" name="Send login rejection" messageRef="Msg_LoginResult"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_LoginRejected" name="Login rejected"/>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Event_WaitOrder" name="Order submission received">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MED_OrderSubmission" messageRef="Msg_OrderSubmission"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:serviceTask id="Task_FinishOrder" name="Finish order"/>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gw_SysFork" name="Prepare payment and shipment"/>
    <bpmn:serviceTask id="Task_PreparePayment" name="Prepare payment"/>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Event_PaymentDataReceived" name="Payment data received">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MED_PaymentData" messageRef="Msg_PaymentData"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:serviceTask id="Task_PrepareShipment" name="Prepare shipment"/>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Event_ShippingReceived" name="Shipping address received">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MED_ShippingAddress" messageRef="Msg_ShippingAddress"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gw_SysJoin" name="Address and payment completed"/>
    <bpmn:serviceTask id="Task_CompleteOrder" name="Complete order"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_OrderCompleted" name="Order completed"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_S01" sourceRef="Start_LoginRequest" targetRef="Task_CheckCredentials"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_S02" sourceRef="Task_CheckCredentials" targetRef="Gw_CredValid"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_S03" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gw_CredValid" targetRef="Task_SendLoginSuccess">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${credentialsValid}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_S04" name="No" sourceRef="Gw_CredValid" targetRef="Task_SendLoginFailure">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${!credentialsValid}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_S05" sourceRef="Task_SendLoginSuccess" targetRef="Event_WaitOrder"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_S06" sourceRef="Task_SendLoginFailure" targetRef="End_LoginRejected"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_S07" sourceRef="Event_WaitOrder" targetRef="Task_FinishOrder"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_S08" sourceRef="Task_FinishOrder" targetRef="Gw_SysFork"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_S09" sourceRef="Gw_SysFork" targetRef="Task_PreparePayment"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_S10" sourceRef="Gw_SysFork" targetRef="Task_PrepareShipment"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_S11" sourceRef="Task_PreparePayment" targetRef="Event_PaymentDataReceived"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_S12" sourceRef="Task_PrepareShipment" targetRef="Event_ShippingReceived"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_S13" sourceRef="Event_PaymentDataReceived" targetRef="Gw_SysJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_S14" sourceRef="Event_ShippingReceived" targetRef="Gw_SysJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_S15" sourceRef="Gw_SysJoin" targetRef="Task_CompleteOrder"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_S16" sourceRef="Task_CompleteOrder" targetRef="End_OrderCompleted"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
